meta.title: Week 10 2026 NFL injury tracking and lineup-deficiency analysis
meta.method: Every row is transcribed from the official NFL Week 10 injury report page (fetched 2026-11-12). Injury names are added only where an official NFL.com source states them (SRC-DD-03). Deficiency chains pair a starter status (official report/news) with the replacement order published on the team's own depth chart (SRC-DD-10..SRC-DD-37). Blank cells with a flagged note mean no official source confirmed the value — nothing is inferred.
